state.description: Current state of the DID exchange

imageUrl.description: Avatar URL advertised by the peer

outOfBandId.description: Out-of-Band identifier this connection started from, or null when it has none

parentConnectionId.description: Connection on which the agent sent the invitation that produced this connection, or null for every other connection

invitationDid.description: DID of the invitation this connection started from

didcommVersion.description: DIDComm version negotiated for this connection. Set only for connections established through the v2 out-of-band flow; absent otherwise.

mediatorId.description: Mediator that routes messages for this connection

updatedAt.description: When the connection was last updated

nextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page. The agent sets it to null on the last page.
